description: Välj vilka du samverkar med på ett klokt sätt: Att genom samverkan hantera ömsesidigt beroende delproblem i hanteringen av skogsbränder is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stockholms universitet. The study applies a network-centric method to investigate wildfire responder networks in Canada and Sweden. It investigates actor collaboration when addressing interdependent tasks, and assesses how certain network structures of actors-and-tasks relationships influence task effectiveness. The published article describes the data in-depth. Coverage: Stockholms universitet. The portal shows the English title as "Choose your collaborators wisely: Addressing interdependent tasks through collaboration in responding to wildfire disast" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stockholms universitet. Its keywords include SOCIALA NÄTVERK, SOCIAL NETWORKS, Skogsbränder, Wildfires. The listing shows 2022-05-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
